plain.text: So the heavens and the earth were completed. By the seventh day God had finished his work, and he rested. God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creation.

This is the account of the heavens and the earth. Before there were plants, the LORD God formed the man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being. God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, and put the man there. He made beautiful trees with good fruit grow, including the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. A river watered the garden and divided into four rivers. God put the man in the garden to work it and take care of it. He told him, "You may eat freely from any tree in the garden, but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for on the day you eat of it, you will surely die."

The LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him." God brought the animals to the man to see what he would name them, but no suitable helper was found. So God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, took one of his ribs, and made a woman from it. He brought her to the man, who said, "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh." That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh. The man and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.

summary.bigIdea: God gives rest, breathes life into the first man, places him in a garden, and creates the woman as his partner.
points: God rests on the seventh day and makes it holy.
God forms the man and breathes life into him, giving him work and one command.
"It is not good for the man to be alone": God makes the woman, and they become one.
summary.reflection: God said it was not good for the man to be alone. Who are the people God has given you to share life with?
